title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Drexel University
description: Ten under-21 destinations for studying, exercising, meals, snacks, and practical supplies after the daytime campus schedule winds down. Hours and access can change, so check the linked source before leaving.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Study Run
cards.subtitle: Hagerty Library’s after-hours workspace
cards.notes: This is the board’s on-campus, no-purchase option for work that continues after Hagerty Library closes.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock Drexel study space with seating, charging kiosks, whiteboards, restrooms, and vending machines.
cards.evidence_claim: Drexel identifies the Dragons’ Learning Den inside Hagerty Library as a 24-hour study space with seating, charging kiosks, whiteboards, restrooms, and vending machines.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7. After the main library closes, Drexel community members enter through the 33rd-and-Ludlow doors using a Dragon Card.

cards.title: The Quiet Reset
cards.subtitle: A reservable room inside the Learning Den
cards.notes: Its location within the 24-hour Den makes it a distinct late option when the need is a short, quiet break rather than another group table.
cards.short_summary: A small wellness room intended for meditation, puzzles, or yoga.
cards.evidence_claim: Drexel says the Serenity Suite in room 109 of the Dragons’ Learning Den is available 24/7 or whenever the Den is open and supports meditation, puzzles, and yoga for up to two people.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are recommended. Walk-ins may request the key at the Service Desk; after-hours Den entry requires eligible Drexel access.

cards.title: The Late Workout Window
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation into the evening
cards.notes: This adds an active, non-food stop directly on campus, with later closing times on the posted weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: Fitness floors, an elevated track, courts, exercise rooms, and a climbing wall under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Drexel’s official facilities page lists Recreation Center winter-term closing times of 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 10 p.m. Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Eligibility rules apply. The cited schedule is term-specific; check current-day hours and closures before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Old Nelson Food Company — 3600 Market Street
cards.title: The Market-Street Deli Stop
cards.subtitle: Sandwiches and essentials west of the academic core
cards.notes: The combination of prepared food and market goods makes this a practical early-evening run near Drexel rather than an after-midnight destination.
cards.short_summary: An independently operated deli and market offering made-to-order food, groceries, snacks, and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: The location’s official site lists service until 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 8 p.m. Friday, with the deli counter closing 30 minutes earlier.
cards.source_title: Old Nelson Food Co. — 3600 Market St, Philadelphia
cards.access_notes: Saturday closes at 6 p.m. and Sunday is closed. The deli counter closes before the store.

cards.title: The Powelton Calzone Run
cards.subtitle: A food counter at 3235 Powelton Avenue
cards.notes: Its Powelton Avenue address places a late-food option on the residence-hall side of Drexel’s University City campus.
cards.short_summary: A calzone-focused restaurant offering pickup and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough’s official Philadelphia menu identifies the 3235 Powelton Avenue location and markets it as open late.
cards.access_notes: The menu does not state operating hours and directs customers to the company website; verify current hours and ordering availability before leaving.

cards.title: The Round-the-Clock Chestnut Stop
cards.subtitle: Prepared food, drinks, and convenience items
cards.notes: A 24-hour store on Chestnut Street supplies a flexible option when restaurant kitchens or campus dining locations are closed.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours convenience store with prepared food, coffee, beverages, snacks, and an ATM.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn’s official retail directory lists the Wawa at 3604 Chestnut Street as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: The directory lists daily, 24-hour service. Confirm the listing before making a late trip because retail hours can change.

cards.title: The 24/7 Lancaster-Avenue Run
cards.subtitle: Hot food, snacks, drinks, and basic services
cards.notes: The Lancaster Avenue address provides an all-hours convenience stop near Drexel’s northern campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store with hot foods, drinks, an ATM, delivery, and an Amazon Locker.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven’s official location page identifies the store at 3401 Lancaster Avenue as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The official page currently says open 24/7. Check for temporary closures before departure.

cards.title: The After-Midnight Chicken Run
cards.subtitle: Late counter service at 3925 Walnut Street
cards.notes: This is a later food option west of campus, with dine-in availability extending past midnight on part of the weekly schedule.
cards.short_summary: A chicken-finger restaurant with dine-in and later general operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official page lists general hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes at midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane’s in Philadelphia, PA — 3925 Walnut Street
cards.access_notes: Dine-in closes earlier than the location’s general operating hours. Verify the desired ordering method and current schedule.

cards.title: The Midnight Chestnut-Street Meal
cards.subtitle: A campus-edge restaurant at 3200 Chestnut Street
cards.notes: Its location between 32nd and 33rd streets makes it one of the closest externally operated late-meal options to Drexel’s academic core.
cards.short_summary: A counter-service restaurant offering burgers, chicken, hot dogs, frozen custard, and other menu items.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s official University City page lists closing at midnight Thursday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday.
cards.source_title: Shake Shack at 3200 Chestnut Street Philadelphia, PA
cards.access_notes: The restaurant also sells alcohol, but it is not a 21+-only venue; this card concerns its general food service. Check current hours before visiting.

cards.title: The No-Closing-Time Snack Break
cards.subtitle: Vending inside Drexel’s 24-hour Den
cards.notes: This is the simplest on-campus fallback when the goal is a snack or drink without leaving the same round-the-clock study facility.
cards.short_summary: Vending machines located inside the 24-hour Dragons’ Learning Den.
cards.evidence_claim: Drexel’s library location page states that the 24-hour Dragons’ Learning Den includes vending machines.
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Den. After Hagerty Library closes, eligible Drexel community members need a Dragon Card to enter.

warnings: Late-night hours can change without notice; verify the linked source on the day of the run.
The Dragons’ Learning Den, Serenity Suite, and Den vending area are separately recognizable destinations or facilities within the same building; their access requirements overlap.
Alcohol may appear on Shake Shack’s broader menu, but the restaurant is not presented as a bar or 21+-only venue, and this board recommends only its general food service.
